query:
SELECT 
  m1.attendeeId,
  m1.timeSlot,
  s1.companyName as sponsor1,
  s2.companyName as sponsor2,
  m1.id as meeting1_id,
  m2.id as meeting2_id
FROM meetings m1
JOIN meetings m2 ON m1.attendeeId = m2.attendeeId 
  AND m1.timeSlot = m2.timeSlot 
  AND m1.id < m2.id
JOIN sponsors s1 ON s1.id = m1.sponsorId
JOIN sponsors s2 ON s2.id = m2.sponsorId
WHERE m1.isVisible = 1 AND m2.isVisible = 1
ORDER BY m1.attendeeId, m1.timeSlot;
